title: Sources and records: 11+ NSA and US Cyber Command personnel died by suicide over the 12 months to September, prompting White House and Congressional questions (Jake Bleiberg/Bloomberg)
summary: Jake Bleiberg / Bloomberg: Sources and records: 11+ NSA and US Cyber Command personnel died by suicide over the 12 months to September, prompting White House and Congressional questions — At least 11 National Security Agency and US Cyber Command workers died by suicide over roughly the past year …
